title: Astro Portal API v1 weather
description: GET /v1/weather query and response (packages/portal/src/astronomy-weather.server.js). Public read: a thin wrapper over the same process-shared, fallback-aware forecast cache (Open-Meteo, MET Norway on failure) the web planner reads. The hourly series run from two days before today to fifteen days after it (sixteen days of forecast: the first eleven, 0-10 days out, reliable, the last five only a trend); MET Norway answers what it can and the days it cannot are beyond range. A present Authorization header must still be a valid device bearer.
